items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: once I discovered him, I wouldn’t let him out of my sight

ctx.x: Well, some of my favorite Venuti stories were stories that happened when I wasn’t even in the band. In fact they go back to Paul Whiteman, I think one of my very favorites is, he’s working with Paul Whiteman for about a year and they are playing at the Chase Hotel in St. Louis, this is 1930, in the teeth of the depression and that’s Joe’s hometown. So, he was staying at the hotel, the band was making great money, even though everybody else was starving and he goes up to Whiteman while he’s there and he says,…
